Session 1. No prior journal; starting flat with $50k cash.

Market read (through 2025-03-31): broad, accelerating risk-off downtrend. Most cyclicals/high-multiple tech made fresh lows into month-end: MRVL ~-34%, APP ~-30%, AVGO ~-29%, CEG ~-24%, DXCM/META/ARM ~-22-23%, AMZN ~-21%, GOOGL/MSFT new lows, NVDA -14%. No bottom signal (breadth weak, new lows expanding, heavy down-volume).

Relative strength concentrated in defensives: MNST +12%, ALNY +10%, ORLY +6%, AXON +6%, FANG +5%, EXC +5% (new highs), MDLZ +3%, CHTR/AEP/PAYX/VRTX flat-to-up. Utilities/staples/energy/healthcare clearly outperforming.

Action: scale in ~40% ($20k), tilted to relative strength and defensiveness rather than catching falling knives: EXC, AEP (utilities, uptrend), MDLZ (staples), MNST (best momentum), ORLY (defensive retail, strong), FANG (energy), VRTX (resilient healthcare), CDNS (only strong semi), CSCO (defensive mega-cap tech). Hold ~$30k cash (60%) because the trend is down and unconfirmed.

Plan/reconsider triggers: add growth (MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/NVDA) only if breadth improves and indexes stop making new lows; add to defensives or keep raising cash if the decline broadens. Reassess each session; no gap risk (dollar-sized orders).

Session 2 (2025-04-02; data through 2025-04-01).

Regime: broad risk-off downtrend still intact. 04-01 produced a broad one-day oversold bounce (MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/META/NVDA/TSLA/APP green, several +1-7%), but breadth is unconfirmed and prices remain well below mid/late-March levels, so I treat it as a relief bounce, not a bottom. Leadership still defensive: utilities (EXC new high 3/31, AEP), staples/consumer (MDLZ, KDP, WMT, COST strong; MNST new highs), payments/data (PAYX/ADP/VRSK up). Semis/cyclicals remain the epicenter of selling.

Book review: defensive core intact (EXC 45.92, AEP 108.37, MDLZ 67.65, MNST 59.04 new high, ORLY 1431.8 strong, CSCO 61.8 stable, FANG 160.87). Laggard = CDNS: -5.6% over the month and -1.75% over 5 days, a high-beta semi in a semis-led selloff that failed to reclaim its late-March range. VRTX pulled back (513->485, worst 5-day -3.1%) but is +2.8% over the month in defensive healthcare; kept, flagged.

Action: SELL CDNS (~$2.0k), redeploy into EXC (+$2.0k) - cut the clear laggard, pyramid the strongest defensive uptrend. Equity stays ~40%, cash ~$30k (60%). No growth additions because breadth is not confirmed.

Reconsider: add growth (MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/META/SHOP/NVDA) only if indexes stop making new lows and breadth improves for 2+ sessions; trim VRTX if it loses 471; raise cash if utilities/staples leadership starts to underperform.

Session 3 (2025-04-03; data through 2025-04-02).

Regime: downtrend from late Feb; a low on 3/31, then two up sessions (4/1, 4/2). Leadership of the bounce is high-beta/beaten-down (TSLA +5.3%, APP +2.7%, AVGO +2.1%, AMZN +2.0% on 4/2) while mega-cap tech stalled (MSFT -0.0%, GOOGL -0.0%, META -0.4%, NVDA +0.2%) and my defensives weakened (MDLZ -2.3%, ORLY -1.0%, AEP -0.6%). Breadth improved for 2 sessions, which meets my stated add-condition, but quality confirmation is thin and volatility is extreme, so I add only small size.

Book: core kept (EXC 45.97, AEP 107.75, MNST 59.36 new high, ORLY 1417, FANG 161.49, VRTX 483.49 >471 trigger, CSCO 61.82). Cut MDLZ (66.13): clearest laggard, broke its range on 4/2 elevated volume, staples leadership fading.

Action: SELL MDLZ (~$1.94k) -> BUY AMZN $1.5k + GOOGL $1.0k (quality mega-caps bouncing off lows). Equity ~$22k (~44%), cash ~$29.5k (~56%).

Reconsider: if defensives keep bleeding and growth follows through 2-3 more sessions, rotate further risk-on (add META/MSFT/AVGO). If the bounce fails and indexes take out the 3/31 lows, raise cash and cut high-beta. Trim VRTX if it loses 471; trim EXC/AEP if utilities leadership breaks.

Session 4 (2025-04-04; data through 2025-04-03).

Regime: risk-off accelerated violently on 4/3. The bounce failed and high-beta made new lows: AMZN -9.0% (196.01->178.41 on 95M vol), CSCO -7.3% (61.82->57.31 on 40M vol), FANG -12.5% (161.49->141.28), GOOGL -4.0%; every one took out its 3/31 low. My committed rule was explicit: 'if the bounce fails and indexes take out the 3/31 lows, raise cash and cut high-beta.' Trigger met. Meanwhile the defensive core held and even rose on strong closes: EXC +2.7% to 47.23 (12.7M vol, near high), AEP +1.3% to 109.11, ORLY +1.75% to 1441.89 (recovered from a 1403 low), MNST +0.5% to 59.65, VRTX flat at 484 (holding 471 support). Classic flight-to-safety: strong signatures in utilities/staples/healthcare, weak closes in tech/energy.

Action: cut the four broken high-beta positions (FANG, CSCO, AMZN, GOOGL) - the 'quality mega-cap bounce' thesis is invalidated. Keep the defensive core (EXC, AEP, MNST, ORLY, VRTX) as relative-strength anchors. Proceeds go to cash: ~$35.6k cash (~72%), ~$14.2k equity (~28%). No new buys - breadth is deteriorating, not improving, and I don't catch falling knives in an accelerating downtrend.

Reconsider: redeploy cash only when indexes stop making new lows AND breadth improves for 2+ sessions (watch MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/NVDA/META reclaiming prior-day highs). Trim VRTX if it loses 471; trim EXC/AEP if utilities leadership breaks. If the selloff exhausts on a high-volume reversal day, selectively rebuild quality mega-cap tech with dry powder.

Session 5 (2025-04-07; data through 2025-04-04).

Regime: 4/4 was an indiscriminate liquidation/capitulation day, not rotation. Everything closed at/near lows on expanding volume: NVDA -7.4% (532M vol), AAPL -6.6%, AVGO -5.2%, META -5.1%, AMZN -4.2% (123M), PLTR -11.5%. Havens were sold too: WMT -4.6%, COST -5.0%, PEP -3.1%, GILD -4.6%, AMGN -4.9%, XEL -5.9%, ADP -6.3%, VRSK -6.7%, PAYX -6.6%, LIN -6.2%. My core (EXC -4.0%, AEP -4.2%, MNST -4.3%, ORLY -3.6%, VRTX -1.9%) gapped up then reversed but held relatively better than the tape. Volume expanded but it was not an up-reversal day, so my 'rebuild quality tech on a high-volume reversal' condition is NOT met.

Action: HOLD all five (EXC, AEP, MNST, ORLY, VRTX). No buys: no breadth/low confirmation, and I don't catch falling knives. No sells: already ~72% cash (35.4k) and ~28% equity; selling relative-strength anchors into a panic close (likely gap-down Monday open) locks losses at the worst point. Utilities did not underperform the broad tape on 4/4, so my trim EXC/AEP trigger is not clean. VRTX intraday low 473.6 held the 471 trigger; kept.

Reconsider: deploy dry powder only after indexes stop making new lows AND breadth improves for 2+ sessions (watch MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/META/NVDA reclaiming prior highs, up-volume). Trim VRTX on a close below 471; trim EXC/AEP only if utilities clearly underperform a flat/up tape. If a genuine high-volume up-reversal day appears, selectively rebuild quality mega-cap tech.

Session 6 (2025-04-08; data through 2025-04-07).

Regime: 4/7 was a genuine high-volume up-reversal day off deeply oversold lows — the condition I pre-committed to act on. High-beta gapped down hard then closed green: NVDA 86.62 low -> 97.64 (+3.5%, 611M vol), META 481.9 -> 516.25 (+2.3%), AMZN 161.4 -> 175.26 (+2.5%), AVGO 138.1 -> 154.14 (+5.4%), PLTR 66.1 -> 77.84 (+5.2%), GOOGL 140.5 -> 146.75 (+0.8%). MSFT reversed 344.8 -> 357.86; AAPL still red (-3.7%) but well off its low. Volume expanded broadly. Meanwhile prior havens closed red (PEP -2.3%, GILD -1.6%, AMGN -1.6%, XEL -1.2%, LIN -2.8%, TMUS -0.6%) — leadership rotating from defensives back toward beaten-down growth.

Action: selectively rebuild quality mega-cap tech with dry powder: BUY MSFT $2,500, GOOGL $2,500, AMZN $2,500, META $2,500 ($10k). Chose low-tariff-exposure quality (software/ad/services) over AAPL (deep red, most tariff-exposed). Hold all five defensives: no trim triggered — VRTX intraday low 448 but CLOSED 474.56 > 471 trigger (sharp reversal, constructive); utilities underperformed only on an intraday-down tape, not a flat/up tape.

Posture: ~52% cash (~$25.4k), ~48% equity; keep a buffer since this is only the first reversal session.

Reconsider: add further only if indexes stop making new lows and breadth improves 2+ sessions (MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/META/NVDA holding above 4/7 lows on up-volume). If 4/7 lows fail on a close, cut the new tech adds and revert defensive. Trim VRTX on a close below 471; trim EXC/AEP if utilities clearly underperform a flat/up tape; trim ORLY if it keeps breaking down (closed 1333.84 near low, below the 1390-1450 range).

Session 7 (2025-04-09; data through 2025-04-08).

Regime: 4/8 was a broad FAILED BOUNCE - everything gapped up then reversed to close near the lows on heavy volume: MSFT 368.3->354.6 (-1.0%), AMZN 185.2->170.7 (-2.6%), META 543->510 (-1.1%), NVDA 103.8->96.3 (-1.4%), AAPL 186.7->172.4 (-5.0%), AVGO faded 169.8->156.0, PLTR 86.1->77.3. BUT the 4/7 lows held on a CLOSE for my tech (MSFT 354.56>344.79; GOOGL 144.70>140.53; AMZN 170.66>161.38; META 510.45>481.90; NVDA 96.30>86.62). So my pre-committed 'cut tech on a close below 4/7 lows' trigger is NOT met - hold, but the bounce is on probation. AAPL did break, confirming the most tariff-exposed names stay weakest. Utilities were the clean relative strength: EXC 44.49, AEP 101.28, XEL 67.04 all ~flat while the tape fell 1-3%.

Action: cut the two anchors that broke support. SELL MNST (55.01, -3.7% on 19.3M shares ~4x normal - high-volume breakdown to new lows, no longer relative strength) and SELL ORLY (1315.20, 4th straight down session and new low; my 'keeps breaking down' trigger met). Hold EXC/AEP (utilities leading), VRTX (closed 472.37 > 471 trigger), and the four tech adds (rule-based). Proceeds to cash, lifting cash to ~$30k (~62%).

Reconsider: redeploy only after 2+ up sessions / breadth confirmation. Cut MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/META if 4/9 closes below their 4/7 lows (344.79 / 140.53 / 161.38 / 481.90). Trim VRTX on a close below 471; trim EXC/AEP if utilities stop leading; reassess MNST/ORLY only on a clear reversal.

Session 8 (2025-04-10; data through 2025-04-09).

Regime: 4/9 was a violent, high-volume risk-on reversal - a follow-through day. Everything ripped and closed near its high on expanding volume: NVDA 96.30->114.33 (+18.7%, 613M), AMD +23.8%, TSLA +22.7%, AVGO +18.7%, PLTR +19.0%, AAPL 172.42->198.85 (+15.3%), META 510.45->585.77 (+14.7%), AMZN 170.66->191.10 (+12.0%), MSFT 354.56->390.49 (+10.1%), GOOGL 144.70->158.71 (+9.7%). Volume rose vs 4/8 on every name. The whole tariff panic (4/3-4/7) was erased in one day. My pre-committed sell triggers were NOT met: MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/META closed far above their 4/7 lows, VRTX closed 482.30 > 471. Defensives lagged: EXC -0.4% (down while the tape ripped), AEP +1.1% - utilities stopped leading.

Action: rotate out of the laggard defensive and add to quality growth. SELL all EXC (~$4.84k; 4th down day, weak on a strongly up tape, printed a 42.85 low). BUY MSFT $2.6k, GOOGL $2.6k, AMZN $2.6k, META $2.2k, NVDA $1.5k (~$11.5k): lower-tariff-exposure mega-cap quality plus a small semi-leader position. Keep AEP as ballast and VRTX (non-tech diversifier, >471). Posture ~53% equity / ~47% cash: participate in the recovery but hold a buffer, since this is still a single headline-driven day and 4/8 showed gap-ups can unwind.

Reconsider: add further only after another up session / breadth confirmation. If 4/10 closes below the 4/9 lows (MSFT 353.10, GOOGL 143.91, AMZN 169.93, META 502.11, NVDA 97.53) the follow-through failed - cut the new adds. Trim AEP if it lags another up tape; trim VRTX on a close below 471.

Session 9 (2025-04-11; data through 2025-04-10).

Regime: 4/10 was a broad give-back day that DIGESTED the 4/9 follow-through without breaking it. All my names closed lower vs 4/9 but every one held its 4/9 low and finished off the intraday low: MSFT 390.49->381.35 (-2.3%, closed at ~93% of range - strongest), GOOGL 158.71->152.82 (-3.7%), AMZN 191.10->181.22 (-5.2%), NVDA 114.33->107.57 (-5.9%, ~72% of range), META 585.77->546.29 (-6.7%, closed weak near low - weakest megacap). Volume fell on every name vs the 4/9 spike: normal post-FTD digestion, not distribution. Defensives re-asserted - AEP +0.8% and WMT +1.1% closed green on a down tape.

Action: HOLD all 7 positions, no trades. My pre-committed framework required (a) an add only after another UP session / breadth confirmation - 4/10 was down, so no add; and (b) a cut of the tech adds only on a close below the 4/9 lows (MSFT 353.10, GOOGL 143.91, AMZN 169.93, META 502.11, NVDA 97.53) - none hit. VRTX closed 475.49 > 471 trigger; AEP showed relative strength so no trim. Posture unchanged: ~52% equity / ~48% cash ($23.4k).

Reconsider: Add / deploy cash only on a confirmed up session or breadth thrust (buy quality growth - MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/NVDA). Cut the tech adds if any closes below its 4/9 low - that would flip back to failed-bounce and I'd raise cash. Trim VRTX on a close below 471; trim AEP if it lags a flat/up tape. META is the weakest close - if it breaks 502 and lags, reduce it.

Session 10 (2025-04-14; data through 2025-04-11).

Regime: 4/11 was the confirmed UP session my framework required. Broad strength, closing near highs: GOOGL 152.82->157.14 (+2.8%, ~94% of range), NVDA 107.57->110.93 (+3.1%), AMZN 181.22->184.87 (+2.0%), MSFT 381.35->388.45 (+1.9%). Sequence 4/9 follow-through -> 4/10 digest -> 4/11 resume is constructive. META was the lone red (-0.5%) but recovered to ~80% of range, still >502. AEP +1.4% (ballast, participating), VRTX +1.8% to 484.22 (well >471 trigger). No pre-committed stops hit.

Action: DEPLOY ~$9k of the ~$23.4k cash into lower-tariff-exposure quality growth: BUY MSFT $2.5k, GOOGL $2.5k, AMZN $2.3k, NVDA $1.7k. Hold all existing positions (AEP ballast, VRTX, META laggard but intact). Cash falls to ~$14.4k (~29%); equity ~71%. Keeping a real buffer because this remains a headline-driven tape where gap-ups have unwound before (4/8).

Reconsider: Cut the tech adds if any closes below its 4/9 low (MSFT 353.10, GOOGL 143.91, AMZN 169.93, META 502.11, NVDA 97.53) - that flips back to failed-bounce, raise cash. META: reduce if it breaks 502 and lags. Trim VRTX below 471; trim AEP if it lags a clearly up tape. Otherwise hold and add only on further breadth confirmation.

Session 11 (2025-04-15; data through 2025-04-14).

Regime: 4/14 was a broad GAP-UP THAT FADED - the unwind risk I flagged (see 4/8). Big opening gaps bled through the day: AAPL opened +6.7% (211.44) but closed only +2.2% (202.52); AMZN -1.5%, AVGO -2.0%, AMD -1.1%, PLTR -3.2%, APP -5.6%, MU -1.9%, MRVL -2.1%. Defensives/quality led and held near highs: WMT +2.1%, COST +1.7%, XEL +1.7%, AEP +1.9%, VRTX +2.4%, MELI +2.0% - a risk-off/rotation undertone even as the tape opened strong. No pre-committed stop hit: nothing closed below its 4/9 low (MSFT 353.10, GOOGL 143.91, AMZN 169.93, META 502.11, NVDA 97.53). VRTX 495.83 >> 471; AEP leading (ballast working).

Action: TRIM META ~half (sell ~$2.25k). META is the clear structural laggard - 585.77 -> 546.29 -> 543.57 -> 531.48, four lower closes, weakest megacap, closed on its low while GOOGL made a new closing high (159.07). Cutting the weakest link lowers concentration in the megacap-tech cohort that faded together and raises cash to ~$16.6k (~31%). HOLD MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, AEP, VRTX - no stop triggered and no breadth confirmation to justify adds, so no buys into a faded tape.

Reconsider: cut the growth adds if any closes below its 4/9 low (MSFT 353.10, GOOGL 143.91, AMZN 169.93, META 502.11, NVDA 97.53) - that flips back to failed-bounce, raise cash. Exit the remaining META if it breaks 502. Trim VRTX below 471; trim AEP if it lags a clearly up tape. Deploy cash only on another confirmed up/broad session (add quality growth). Otherwise hold.

Session 12 (2025-04-16; data through 2025-04-15).

Regime: 4/15 was MIXED-TO-SOFT - the megacap-tech cohort rolled over a second straight session after 4/14's faded gap-up, while defensives/quality led. Weak closes: GOOGL -1.7% (156.31, ~25% of range), AMZN -1.4% (near low), META -1.9% (521.52, fresh lower low, weakest), MSFT -0.5% (~20% of range). Firm: NVDA +1.3% (near high), VRTX +0.9% (~84% of range), AEP +0.1%. So the risk-off/defensive rotation I flagged on 4/15 continues; leadership is utilities/health + NVDA, laggards are the megacap-tech cohort.

Rule checks (pre-committed): (1) Cut growth on a close below the 4/9 lows - MSFT 353.10, GOOGL 143.91, AMZN 169.93, META 502.11, NVDA 97.53 - NONE breached (META 521.52 > 502). (2) Exit remaining META below 502 - not triggered. (3) Trim VRTX below 471 - 500.49, not triggered. (4) Trim AEP only if it lags a clearly up tape - 4/15 was not up, AEP firm. (5) Deploy cash only on a confirmed up/broad session - 4/15 was mixed/soft, no signal.

Action: HOLD all 7 positions, no trades. Nothing triggered and there is no breadth confirmation for adds, so I neither cut into weakness (META is near its 481-494 support and I will not sell above my 502 stop) nor chase. Cash ~$16.6k (~34%) is the standing defensive tilt.

Reconsider: Cut the growth adds if any closes below its 4/9 low (MSFT 353.10, GOOGL 143.91, AMZN 169.93, META 502.11, NVDA 97.53) - flips to failed-bounce, raise cash. Exit META on a close below 502. Trim VRTX below 471; trim AEP if it lags a clearly up tape. Deploy the cash buffer only on a confirmed up/broad session (add quality growth - MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/NVDA), noting a fresh $50k deposit lands May 1. Otherwise hold.

Session 13 (2025-04-17; data through 2025-04-16).

Regime: 4/16 was a broad DOWN day led by megacap tech - the risk-off rotation I flagged on 4/15-4/16 turned into outright selling. NVDA -6.9% (112.20->104.49), MSFT -3.7% (closed 371.61 near low 368), META -3.7% (closed 502.31, broke its 4/9 intraday low of 502.11 with a 495.63 low), AMZN -3.0%. GOOGL -1.9% (mid-range). Defensive AEP held (-0.7%). So leadership is utilities/health; the cohort that led the 4/7-4/9 bounce is now lagging.

Rule checks (pre-committed): (1) Cut growth on a close below the 4/9 lows - MSFT 353.10, GOOGL 143.91, AMZN 169.93, META 502.11, NVDA 97.53 - NONE closed below (MSFT 371.61, GOOGL 153.33, AMZN 174.33, NVDA 104.49). (2) Exit remaining META below 502 - META broke the level intraday and closed at 502.31, effectively AT the trigger; META is my clearly weakest name (585.77->546.29->543.57->531.48->521.52->502.31, six lower closes). (3) Trim VRTX below 471 - 485.89, not triggered. (4) Trim AEP if it lags a clearly up tape - 4/16 was down, AEP firm, no trim. (5) Deploy cash only on a confirmed up/broad session - 4/16 was down, no signal.

Action: SELL the remaining META (~4.196 units, ~$2.1k) to complete the exit - the breakdown is confirmed (fresh lower low + close at the 502 stop) and it is the weakest cohort member. HOLD MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, AEP, VRTX: no 4/9 low was breached, so I do not cut the core into weakness. Cash rises to ~$18.7k (~39%) - a deliberate defensive tilt into a deteriorating tape.

Reconsider: Cut the growth core if any CLOSES below its 4/9 low (MSFT 353.10, GOOGL 143.91, AMZN 169.93, NVDA 97.53) - flips to failed-bounce, raise cash. Trim VRTX below 471; trim AEP if it lags a clearly up tape. Deploy the cash buffer only on a confirmed up/broad session (add quality growth - MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/NVDA), noting a fresh $50k deposit lands May 1. Otherwise hold.

Session 14 (2025-04-21; data through 2025-04-17).

Regime: 4/17 was a MIXED-to-soft ROTATION day, not the broad down day of 4/16 nor a broad up day. Laggards were megacap tech/semis: MSFT -1.0% (367.78, near low 366.89), GOOGL -1.4% (151.16, low 148.50), AMZN -1.0% (172.61), NVDA -2.9% (101.49, low 100.05, a clear downtrend 114.33->101.49 over six sessions), AVGO -2.1%, AMD -0.9%. Leaders were defensives/quality: AEP +1.7% (107.71, near high 109.03), VRTX +0.7%, WMT +2.2%, COST +2.8%, XEL +1.5%, MELI +1.7%, AAPL +1.4% (196.98). So the risk-off/defensive rotation persists; my core cohort is the laggard group.

Rule checks (pre-committed): (1) Cut growth core on a close below the 4/9 lows - MSFT 353.10 (367.78), GOOGL 143.91 (151.16), AMZN 169.93 (172.61), NVDA 97.53 (101.49) - NONE breached. (2) META exit already completed 4/17; it closed 501.48, below the 502 trigger, validating the exit. (3) Trim VRTX below 471 - 489.10, not triggered. (4) Trim AEP if it lags a clearly up tape - 4/17 was down/rotational and AEP led; no trim. (5) Deploy cash only on a confirmed up/broad session - 4/17 mixed/rotational, no confirmation.

Action: HOLD all positions, no trades. The core is drifting back toward its 4/9 lows but no stop is breached, so I do not cut into drift; there is no breadth confirmation, so I do not deploy. Cash ~$18.7k (~39%) remains the deliberate defensive tilt into a still-deteriorating megacap tape. A fresh $50k deposit lands May 1, so there is no urgency to force exposure.

Reconsider: Cut the growth core if any CLOSES below its 4/9 low (MSFT 353.10, GOOGL 143.91, AMZN 169.93, NVDA 97.53) - flips to failed-bounce, raise cash. Trim VRTX below 471; trim AEP if it lags a clearly up tape. Deploy the cash buffer only on a confirmed up/broad session (add quality growth - MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN/NVDA, or scale into defensives). Otherwise hold.

Session 15 (2025-04-22; data through 2025-04-21).

Regime: 4/21 was a broad DOWN day and a failed-bounce confirmation for the megacap growth cohort. Closes vs 4/17: MSFT -2.4% (359.12, near low 355.67), GOOGL -2.3% (147.67, near low 146.10), AMZN -3.1% (167.32, closed the low), NVDA -4.5% (96.91, new low 95.04). Broad weakness beyond my book: META -3.4% (484.66), AAPL -1.9% (193.16). Even defensive AEP gave back -2.0% (105.53). So this is a risk-off continuation, not a rotation; the 4/7-4/9 bounce has failed for growth.

Rule checks (pre-committed): (1) Cut the growth core if ANY of MSFT 353.10 / GOOGL 143.91 / AMZN 169.93 / NVDA 97.53 (their 4/9 lows) is breached on a close. AMZN 167.32 < 169.93 AND NVDA 96.91 < 97.53 - TWO breached. TRIGGERED. (2) Trim VRTX below 471 - 477.52, not triggered (hold). (3) Trim AEP if it lags a clearly up tape - 4/21 was down, no trim. (4) Deploy cash only on a confirmed up/broad session - 4/21 was down, no buys.

Action: SELL the entire growth core - NVDA (28.613), AMZN (39.828), MSFT (19.952), GOOGL (48.766) - roughly $23.8k at the 4/21 close. The condition I pre-committed to (any member of the core closing below its 4/9 low) is met by two members, which is the failed-bounce signal by design, so I raise cash rather than hold and hope. I do NOT trim AEP or VRTX - VRTX is above its 471 stop and AEP is my defensive ballast. Cash rises from ~$18.7k to roughly ~$42.5k (~90%); holdings reduce to AEP + VRTX.

Reconsider: Redeploy only on a confirmed up/broad session (a broad green day, not one or two leaders). If NVDA/AMZN reclaim their 4/9 lows (97.53 / 169.93) and MSFT/GOOGL hold, I will begin scaling back into quality growth. Trim VRTX below 471 (it is grinding down: 500.49->485.89->489.10->477.52, low 472.90). Trim AEP if it lags a clearly up tape.
